s: Nokri aksenay im meakkeb ubo seip echad: nokri hanniknas leechad mibbatte hechatzer leshem aksenaut, im niknas shello birshut — eno oser leolam, veim niknas birshut, shehiskiru o hishilu lo cheder meyuchad laakila, im hu ragil labo — oser miyyad beboo, veim eno ragil — eno oser ad leachar sheloshim yom, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a beaksenay yisrael. Venokri sheyyesh lo chob al habbayit niqra "niknas birshut". Veanshe chel hammelek shenniknesu bebatte hayyehudim, mehem bechozqa umehem beratzon, im yesh lebaale battim beotam chadarim shenniknesu bahem hannokrim kelim sheenam nittalim beshabbat — enam oserim alehem bekol inyan, veim lav — oserim bachatzerot shenniknesu bahen birshut leachar l' yom, ap al pi sheenam regilim labo sham. Abal hanniknasim bechozqa enam oserim leolam. (Vekol zeh beaksenaim, sheenam qebuim sham. Abal hammaskir beto lenokri ladur bo biqbiut shana o shenatayim — eno oser bekol inyan, shebbevadday lo hiskir lo beto al daat sheyyeesor alayv biqbiut kol hashshana kullah, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shp"b):
